Hi there.

My name is Raphael Coelho. I'm a financial risks manager and a PhD candidate at EMap FGV's Applied Math program. My academic experience is with stochastic processes, specially those heavily used in quantitative finance.

I just added a PR https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/39349 as part of some work I have been doing in putting together formal proofs for stochastic processes (from Markot to Wiener Integrals). Hopefully it's something worthwile.

Looking forward to hear from you all.
Hey there , can you comment on any AI usage you may have had ?

I am sorry to say there are several issues here. First, the Doob maximal inequality is already being worked on in the brownian motion projet. Second, your PR is much too long, and the code quality is not up to mathlib standards. The reviewing team cannot afford to lose time on those, see https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/#use-of-ai.
Just to double check, @Etienne Marion, you are refering to https://github.com/RemyDegenne/brownian-motion, correct?
